notes.title: Endless achievements
notes.content:
1. Endless related modifications
Our game is designed to provide a relaxed and enjoyable experience
But when we launched the endless leaderboard, we found that players were centered around rankings and engaged in competitive competition.
In order to make the game more enjoyable, we have decided to close the leaderboard and switch to an endless achievement format.
When you reach an endless certain round, it is considered as an endless clearance and achievement.
No need to compare, reject internal competition, relax and entertain, start from me.
2. Fixed the bug where enchanting materials such as magic suction, eagle eye, and the real name of the chief cannot be overlaid when worn simultaneously
3. Add screen vibration switch to game settings

notes.title: The game has finally been released
notes.content:
Great news! The game has finally been released on EA!!!

Compare Demo

We have added 3 chapters, all of which have 5 difficulty levels

2. Added point cards, banned card pools, etc. to make operations smoother

3. Add 15 heroes and 4 bonds

4. More enchanting materials and equipment

5. Introducing a divine skill system can greatly enhance hero skills

6. Introducing a card system, players can now control the battlefield

7. More point based products, rune systems, and other external growth opportunities

8. Introduce achievement, Easter egg and other glory systems to make the game more enjoyable

Please control the game time reasonably, this is just a single player game.
